Skip to contentIMD Issues Orange Alert for Six Telangana Districts, Thunderstorms Till 1 AM
HYDERABAD: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a district-level nowcast warning for Telangana, forecasting moderate rain and thunderstorms in several districts. until 1.00 am IST on July 30.
The IMD has placed Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Mahabubnagar, Mancherial, Mulugu, Peddapalle and Rangareddy districts under an Orange Warning. These districts are likely to receive moderate rain accompanied by moderate thunderstorms.
A Yellow Warning remains in effect for Adilabad, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Hanamkonda, Hyderabad, Jagtial, Jangaon, Jogulamba Gadwal, Kamareddy, Karimnagar, Khammam, Komaram Bheem Asifabad, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Mahabubabad, Medak, Nagarkurnool, Nalgonda, Narayanpet, Nirmal, Nizamabad, Rajanna Sircilla, Sangareddy, Siddipet, Suryapet, Vikarabad, Wanaparthy, Warangal and Yadadri Bhuvanagiri districts.
According to the IMD, these districts may receive light rain of up to 5 mm per hour, along with light thunderstorms and surface wind speeds below 40 kmph.
The weather department has advised residents to remain alert during thunderstorms, avoid taking shelter under isolated trees and keep track of official weather updates until the warning expires.
The IMD issued the district-level nowcast at 10.00 pm IST on July 29, 2026. The warning will remain valid until 1.00 am IST on July 30, 2026.

Orange Alert Issued Across Morocco Amid 47C Heatwave
The hottest conditions are expected in southern and southeastern provinces, where temperatures could climb as high as 47C before easing later in the week.
Casablanca – Morocco’s General Directorate of Meteorology issued an orange weather alert warning of a heatwave and hot weather across several provinces from Wednesday through Saturday.
The most intense heat is forecast from Wednesday to Friday in Oued Ed-Dahab, Boujdour, Assa-Zag, Es-Semara, Taroudant, Tata, Zagora, Errachidia and Aousserd, where temperatures are expected to range between 45C and 47C.
From Wednesday to Saturday, Fquih Ben Salah, El Kelaa des Sraghna and Beni Mellal are expected to record temperatures between 42C and 45C.
The same temperature range is forecast from Thursday to Saturday in Agadir-Ida-Ou-Tanane, Marrakech, Rehamna, Youssoufia, Khenifra, Taounate, Ouezzane, Meknes, Fez, Moulay Yacoub, Sidi Kacem, Khouribga, Settat and Chichaoua.
The weather service also expects hot conditions on Thursday and Friday in Laâyoune, Tarfaya, Guelmim and Tan-Tan, with temperatures ranging from 42C to 45C. During the same period, Essaouira and Sidi Ifni are forecast to see temperatures between 39C and 42C.
On Friday and Saturday, temperatures between 40C and 45C are expected in Sidi Slimane, Benslimane, Khemisset, Safi, Sidi Bennour, Guercif and Taza.
The meteorological bulletin classified the alert at the orange vigilance level.
